$schema.description: The schema of this file, which editors use for completion and validation.

sets.description: The rule sets to select. "default" selects the standards, cleanup, conversion, structure and minification sets. Without sets and rules the default selection is used.

rules.description: true selects a rule, false leaves it out even if a set selects it.

convertCssClassesToAttributes.description: Convert style sheet rules that select a single class to presentation attributes.

convertEllipsesToCircles.description: Convert ellipses with equal radii to circles.

convertInlineStylesToAttributes.description: Convert inline styles to presentation attributes.

convertOneStopGradientsToColors.description: Replace gradients with a single stop by the color of that stop. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

convertShapesToPaths.description: Convert rect, line, polyline and polygon elements to paths.

fixAttributeNames.description: Fix the letter case of attribute names. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

mergeDuplicateGradients.description: Merge identical gradients into one. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

migrateToSvg2.description: Migrate SVG 1.1 and SVG Tiny markup to SVG 2, including deprecated attributes and enable-background.

minifyAttributeWhitespace.description: Remove unnecessary whitespace from attribute values.

minifyColors.description: Write each color in its shortest form: a name, #rgb or #rrggbb.

minifyNumericValues.description: Shorten the notation of numeric attribute values and number lists.

minifyPathData.description: Minify path data without changing coordinates.

minifyStyleSheets.description: Remove comments and whitespace from style elements.

moveCommonAttributesToGroups.description: Move attributes shared by all children of a group onto the group.

moveGroupTransformsToChildren.description: Move the transform of a group onto its children.

prefixIdsAndClasses.description: Prefix ids and class names so they do not conflict with other SVG documents on the same page. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

removeDataAttributes.description: Remove data-* attributes. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

removeDefaultAttributes.description: Remove attributes set to their default value, default type attributes on style and script elements and xml:space="default" where it has no effect.

removeEditorMarkup.description: Remove the elements, attributes and namespace declarations that editors add in their own namespaces.

removeEmptyElements.description: Remove empty containers and empty text elements.

removeForeignContent.description: Remove foreign, embedding and HTML breakout elements and non-canonical names.

removeHiddenElements.description: Remove elements that cannot render anything, including shapes with a zero size.

removeIneffectiveAttributes.description: Remove attributes that have no effect: useless strokes and fills, group attributes that are neither inherited nor apply to groups, and text attributes on elements without text.

removeNonStandardAttributes.description: Remove attributes that are not part of the SVG specification.

removeNonStandardElements.description: Remove elements that are not part of the SVG specification.

removeScripts.description: Remove scripts, event handlers and animations that rewrite links or event handlers.

removeUnsafeMarkup.description: Remove processing instructions and unsafe comments.

removeUnsafeStyles.description: Remove unsafe statements and declarations from style sheets and style attributes.

removeUnsafeUrls.description: Remove attributes with URLs that can run script or load external content.

removeUnusedDefinitions.description: Remove definitions that are not referenced. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

removeUnusedIds.description: Remove ids that are not referenced. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

removeUseBombs.description: Remove use elements that form cycles or render too many instances.

removeWidthHeightAttributes.description: Remove the width and height of the root element when it has a viewBox. Risky: only runs when allowRisky is true.

sortDefinitions.description: Group the children of defs elements by element name.

allowRisky.description: Allow the risky rules that sets or rules select. They may change how the SVG renders or is used.
